book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Cuybanile yin̈ mac chispoh isba yeb yixal
Lahwi yalnicano Comam Jesús huntekꞌan cuybanile tuꞌ xin, yel Comam yul ismajul Galilea, isto Comam yul ismajul txꞌotxꞌ Judea iskꞌaxepicꞌto haꞌ Jordán.
Caw xin hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam, hac tuꞌ xin yu yakꞌni cawxo Comam anma yaꞌay.

Ay xin huntekꞌan ebnaj fariseo apni iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yoc ebnaj yilweno Comam yun̈e yaycꞌay yin̈ hunu ismul, iskꞌamben ebnaj tet Comam: —Mamin, ¿chimyu ispohni isba hunu naj yeb yixal waxan̈ca yu hunu comon tzet ye tuꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam tet ebnaj: —¿Tom maẍto cheyil yul Yum Comam Dios bay chala tato hayet iswatxꞌencano Comam Dios anma, iswatxꞌe Comam Dios naj winaj, iswatxꞌenpaxo Comam ix ix?
Yalni Comam Dios hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Yuxin chacano naj winaj ismam yeb ismiꞌ cat ishunbancano isba naj yeb yixal, hac tuꞌ xin hunxan̈e anmahil chielcanico iscawan̈il, ẍicano Comam.
Yuxin matxa cawan̈o anmahil yehi, to hunxan̈e chielcanicoj. Yuxin haꞌ mac chishunba Comam Dios machi hunu mac chu ispohni,” ẍi Comam Jesús.
Iskꞌambenpaxo ebnaj fariseo tuꞌ tet Comam: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin yalcano naj Moisés tato chu yakꞌlax teꞌ hum yet pohlebahil tet ix ixale cat yalaxcano ix yu yichamil? ẍi ebnaj.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Yu hetxꞌojal yuxin yal naj Moisés huneꞌ tuꞌ ta chu hepohlencano heba yeb heyixal. Wal yet yichebanil yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, mach haco tuꞌ ye yu Comam Dios.
Yuxin chiwalan teyet, haꞌ mac chibejnicano yixal, yajaꞌ ta mach taj yu issayni ix hunuxa winaj, cat ismohyipaxo naj yeb hunuxa ix, yin̈ hacaꞌ tuꞌ chaco naj ismul yul sat Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Yalni ebnaj iscuywom Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Tato matxa chu copohni coba yeb jixal, cꞌulmi mach chijikꞌ jixal chal tuꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam tet ebnaj: —Yajaꞌ mach sunilo mac chiijcha yu yin̈ huneꞌ cheyal tiꞌ, wal xin han̈cꞌan̈e mac yetticꞌa yehi.

Ay ebnaj maẍticꞌa tzꞌajano isnimanil yetticꞌa chipitzcꞌahi, yuxin mach chu yikꞌni ebnaj yixal. Aypaxo ebnaj yet anmahil chiuteni, yuxin mach chu yikꞌnipaxo ebnaj yixal. Aypaxo ebnaj xin yu ismunla yin̈ ismunil Comam Dios yuxin machi yixal. Yuxin haꞌ mac chitecha yu, machojab chikꞌ yixal, ẍi Comam.
Iskꞌan Comam Jesús iscꞌulal Comam Dios yiban̈ niẍte unin

Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yilaxti haywan̈ niẍte unin iscꞌatan̈ Comam Jesús yu yanayo Comam iskꞌab yiban̈, yebpaxo yu istxahli Comam yin̈. Wal ebnaj iscuywom Comam xin, oc ebnaj iscachaꞌ anma ikꞌn̈e niẍte unin tuꞌ.

Yuxin yal Comam tet ebnaj: —Mach checach istit niẍte unin tiꞌ incꞌatan̈an, yuto haꞌ mac chaco yanma yin̈ Comam Dios hacaꞌ yeco yanma niẍte unin tiꞌ yin̈ ismam ismiꞌ, haꞌ chu yoc yul iskꞌab Comam ay yul satcan̈, ẍi Comam.
Yanayo Comam Jesús iskꞌab yiban̈ iswiꞌ niẍte unin tuꞌ, lahwi tuꞌ xin isto Comam.
Huneꞌ naj tzeh caw kꞌalom tzotel tet Comam Jesús
Ay huneꞌ naj tzeh apni iscꞌatan̈ Comam Jesús, iskꞌamben naj tet Comam: —Mam cuywawom, ¿tzet hunu cꞌul inwatxꞌenan yun̈e inchahnihan kꞌinale mach istan̈bal? ẍi naj.

Yalni Comam Jesús tet naj: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin chakꞌambe wetan yin̈ tzet ye tuꞌ cꞌul? Wal xin huneꞌn̈e mac cꞌul. Yaj ta chawoche hachab hakꞌinal mach istan̈bal, yije chejbanile akꞌbilcano yu naj Moisés, ẍi Comam.

Iskꞌamben naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Baytet xin huntekꞌan chejbanile chawal tiꞌ? ẍi naj. Yalni Comam: —Mach chachpotxꞌwahi, mach chachixli yebpaxo mach chachelkꞌawi, yeb mach chahobcan̈ lekꞌtiꞌal yin̈ hawet anmahil.
Yije tzet chal hamam, hamiꞌ, yebpaxo xin xahan chawil hawet anmahil hacaꞌ hayaꞌiln̈en haba, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Istakꞌwi naj tet Comam: —Sunil huntekꞌan chawal tiꞌ yijebilticꞌa wuhan yichitaxticꞌa inchꞌibcan̈an. ¿Tzet hunuxa wal inyijenan? ẍi naj.

Yalni Comam tet naj: —Yajaꞌ ta chawoche chachoccano cꞌulal, as txon̈to sunil tzet ayach, cat hapohnican̈ istohol yin̈ anma mebaꞌ, haxinwal ay hakꞌalomal yul satcan̈. Lahwi tuꞌ cat hawoccano tzujno wintajan, ẍi Comam.
Hayet yaben naj tzeh tuꞌ yalni Comam hacaꞌ tuꞌ, ispaxto naj yin̈ biscꞌulal yuto caw kꞌalomcano naj sicꞌlebil.
Yalni Comam Jesús tet ebnaj iscuywom: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, caw yaꞌta yoc anma kꞌalom yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
Chiwalpaxojan teyet, hacaꞌ hunu noꞌ camello tinan̈, ¿tom subutaj yecꞌto noꞌ yul isholanil hunu chꞌen acuẍa? Hac tuꞌ ye anma kꞌalom, caw yaꞌta yoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios,
ẍi Comam.
Hayet yaben ebnaj iscuywom Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ caw cꞌayilo iscꞌul ebnaj, yalni ebnaj tet hunun: “Ta hac tuꞌ, ¿mactaxca chicolchahi?” ẍi ebnaj.
Yoc tꞌan̈no Comam yin̈ ebnaj, yalni Comam: —Huneꞌ tiꞌ mach chikꞌoji anma iswatxꞌeni, wal Comam Dios sunil tzet chu iswatxꞌen Comam, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Yalni naj Pedro tet Comam: —Mamin, han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ bejbilcano sunil tzet ayon̈an̈ yu joc tzujnojan̈ tawintaj, ¿yuxin tzet chicochahan̈ ispajoj? ẍi naj.

Yalni Comam: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, yet chiapni istiempohal yet chiacꞌbilo sunil tzet ye tuꞌ, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios chinoc tzꞌon̈nojan yul incapilan caw cꞌulchꞌancanoj. Haxa hex chexecꞌ tzujtzun wintatiꞌan, chexoc tzꞌon̈no yul hunun hecapil, cat heyoc heyilni yin̈ tzet chielico cablahon̈eb majan ebnaj Israel.

Yuxin mac chisbejcano yatut wuhan maca yuẍtaj, yanab, maca ismam, maca ismiꞌ, maca yuninal, maca istxꞌotxꞌ; huntekꞌan mac tuꞌ caw ecꞌbalto txꞌiꞌal ispaj selel chiakꞌlax tet, yeb chischah iskꞌinal mach istan̈bal.

Haꞌ mac caw ay yelapno ye tinan̈, yet chiapni huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, caw matxa yelapno chielicoj. Haxa mac machi yelapno ye tinan̈ chijute jilni, yet chiapni huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ caw aycano yelapno chielcanicoj, ẍi Comam.

footnotes.text: Ay teꞌ hum chalni ta isholanil acuẍa chitzotel yin̈ niẍte pulta caw lotꞌan sat yeb caw txann̈e yecan̈ istel ayco yin̈ iscꞌubal con̈ob Jerusalén.
